labels: Claude, an AI assistant, not humans

S_same.what: model says same -> truly the identical item

S_same_or_variant.what: model says same -> at least the same product line

R_same.what: random pair from a search -> identical item (naive baseline)

V_same_model.what: model says other variant -> at least the same product line

V_same.what: model says other variant -> actually the identical item

H_same_model.what: rejected look-alike -> actually the same product line (missed)

listing_same_model_weighted.what: share of listing pairs (S or V) that are the same product line
